summary:
quality lens over backend-observability (11 product path(s), a40b7a1..5867dac, Codex via the autoreview skill at --max-priority P2): 0 blocking, 1 non-blocking. The observability wiring and integration coverage are present, but the global filter violates the error-code contract for every non-validation HTTP 400 response.
VERDICT t9-c1: partial — backend/src/common/global-exception.filter.ts:31 maps all HTTP 400 exceptions to validation failures
VERDICT t9-c2: implemented — backend/src/common/request-logging.middleware.ts:14 installs correlated request logging, paired with the error logging in the global filter
VERDICT t9-c3: implemented — backend/src/common/error-envelope.wiring.test.ts:25 exercises configureApp() followed by app.init()
LEFTOVERS: none detected.

blocking_findings.summary: t9-c1: a global exception filter (constitution 07) maps every unhandled exception and existing HttpException to the full standard error payload (errorId, type, user-facing message, sanitized details, http status, correlationId, requestId, environment, timestampUtc) and is wired app-wide via useGlobalFilters

non_blocking_findings.summary: [P2] Do not classify every 400 HttpException as validation (backend/src/common/global-exception.filter.ts:31): Every status-400 `HttpException` enters this validation branch, so ordinary domain-level `BadRequestException`s receive `VALIDATION_ERROR`, fabricated field details, and the validation user message.
